probes.source:
module Top;
  bit a, clk, y3, y4, y5;
  int n3, n4, n5, p4, f5;
  always @(posedge clk) begin y3 = 0; if (a) y3 = 1; end
  always_ff @(posedge clk) begin y4 <= 0; if (a) y4 <= 1; end
  always @(posedge clk) begin y5 = 0; y5 = 1; end
  initial forever begin @(y3); n3++; end
  initial forever begin @(y4); n4++; end
  initial forever begin @(y5); n5++; end
  initial forever begin @(posedge y4); p4++; end
  initial forever begin @(negedge y5); f5++; end
  initial begin #1 a = 1; #1 clk = 1; #1 clk = 0; #1 clk = 1; #1 clk = 0; #1 clk = 1; #1 $display("blk=%0d nba=%0d const=%0d rise=%0d fall=%0d", n3, n4, n5, p4, f5); $finish; end
endmodule
